subject: [PATCH 5/5] Documentation: iomap: update docs to reflect iomap_iter_next model

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch updates the iomap documentation to reflect a change in how filesystems interact with the iomap API. Specifically, it removes support for separate ->iomap_begin() and ->iomap_end() callbacks, replacing them with a single iomap_iter_next() callback that finishes the previous mapping (if any) and produces the next one. The patch updates documentation across three files to reflect this change.
